changed_behaviour: VariantAnnotation response model gains a new errorMessage string property.
rationale: No contract; model field added, operation not identifiable from diff.

changed_behaviour: Evaluation result segmentID is now set only when a segment yields a variant, instead of always the last evaluated segment.
Pushes updating branches with a merge queue are no longer rejected by the merge-queue branch update rule check.
rationale: Git push hook path, not a REST operation; swagger has no merge queue mention.

changed_behaviour: Hook resources created during sync get app-instance tracking per configured tracking method (annotation/label) with label truncation, rather than only a label.
rationale: Sync op described; hook tracking metadata not mentioned.

changed_behaviour: Bridge responses/requests gain optional websocketConfiguration; several primitive fields no longer marked NotNull.
rationale: No websocket mention anywhere in latest contract.

changed_behaviour: Stream playlist and segment channel query parameter now defaults to 1 instead of 0 when omitted.
Maximum length of path and build fields in generate request raised from 20 to 120.
Command list is now ordered by description.
rationale: Description only says it returns saved commands; no ordering.

changed_behaviour: Location levels listing accepts include-aliases parameter and returns aliases on levels (default false).
Target objects get app-instance tracking reset whenever namespace is modified (cluster-scoped cleared or namespaced defaulted), unified normalisation.
rationale: Internal comparison logic; no specific HTTP operation identifiable.

changed_behaviour: Wallet direct_post endpoint now accepts JARM direct_post.jwt responses with signature verification; invalid ones give invalid state.
Accept header no longer treated as a header that is written to/forwarded in responses (flag true to false).
rationale: Only deployment YAMLs for swagger UI; no API contract.

changed_behaviour: Comment page request now decodes short comment_id into internal ID.
rationale: Contract lists no comment_id query parameter for this operation.

changed_behaviour: GitHub release delete event now unpublishes a published workflow left with no versions, else updates the search index.
rationale: Description covers creation on release only; nothing on deletion or unpublish.

changed_behaviour: OAuth authorize/userinfo/OIDC login placeholder endpoints return 405 failed instead of 200 success; new OIDC redirect route added.
